_comment: Approved parity divergences. ONLY the user may instruct additions/modifications/revocations. Agents must never edit this file (see AGENTS.md). Tools bucket matching entries as EXC (visible, never silent) and --check-stale flags entries that no longer diverge for revocation.

exceptions.reason: Usmap constructor decompresses .usmap.gz before ReadUSMAP. The C# oracle only recognizes .usmap/.jmap/.jmap.gz; a .usmap.gz falls through to ReadUSMAP and throws FormatException, so uasset4j succeeds where the oracle fails.

scope.target: curve types: dedicated FRealCurve/FRichCurve/FSimpleCurve/FCompressedRichCurve/FCurveMetaData/FKeyHandle/UCurveTable/CurveTableExport/UCurveVector/UCurveLinearColor/UCurveLinearColorAtlas (new Apache-2.0 derivative, not UAssetAPI)

exceptions.reason: Curve support is a deliberate extension beyond UAssetAPI (which lacks it), added as Apache-2.0 derivative work of CUE4Parse. New files live in the dedicated curves/ package + CurveTableExport; existing UAssetAPI-ported curve files (FRichCurveKey, RichCurveKeyPropertyData, etc.) are untouched and remain under the MIT parity contract.

scope.target: GenerateUnversionedHeader throws when Mappings is null (write of unversioned properties without a usmap)

exceptions.reason: UAssetAPI does not serialize Mappings (usmap schema) to JSON. After DeserializeJson, Mappings is null; writing an unversioned asset then requires re-attaching Mappings. C# UAssetAPI silently writes no header at all in this case (corrupt output). uasset4j instead throws a clear IllegalStateException telling the caller to re-attach Mappings, preventing silent corruption. This mirrors the read path, which already throws the equivalent error.
